name: Minor Basilica of St. John the Baptist
description: One of the oldest parishes in the Philippines, established by Franciscan missionaries in 1579. The Minor Basilica stands atop a hill overlooking the commercial district, serving as Taytay's spiritual and geographic anchor for over four centuries.

name: Club Manila East
description: A popular resort and recreational complex offering multiple swimming pools, water slides, wave pool, function halls, and picnic areas. A go-to weekend destination for families and groups from Metro Manila and neighboring provinces.
address: Manila East Road, Brgy. San Juan, Taytay, Rizal

name: Bagpi Garment Center
description: One of the oldest and largest wholesale garment centers in Taytay, hosting hundreds of local clothing manufacturer stalls offering factory-direct prices on RTW apparel.
address: Manila East Road, Brgy. San Juan, Taytay, Rizal

name: Epalog de Taytay
description: Famous street food stall and the birthplace of Taytay's most iconic delicacy — the Epalog: a boiled egg coated in orange flour batter, deep-fried, and served with a house sauce. A must-try culinary landmark.
address: Kadlagan Road, Brgy. San Juan, Taytay, Rizal

name: Taytay Mega Tiangge
description: A modern and spacious garments market facility offering a massive selection of budget-friendly fashion apparel directly from local sewers and designers.
address: Manila East Road, Brgy. San Juan, Taytay, Rizal

name: October 18 Garments Market
description: A bustling garments tiangge along Manila East Road featuring stalls from local clothing manufacturers and distributors offering wholesale and retail deals on fashion apparel.

name: Iglesia Garments Center
description: A wholesale garments shopping center within the Manila East corridor, offering a wide array of textile goods, ready-to-wear apparel, and accessories from local Taytay manufacturers.

name: SM Center Taytay
description: SM Center Taytay is a modern retail complex offering supermarkets, fashion outlets, food courts, cinemas, and essential services — one of the main commercial anchors in the municipality.

name: Starmall Taytay
description: A community shopping center along Manila East Road anchored by grocery chains and local retail brands, offering a convenient one-stop destination for Taytay residents.

name: Taytay Public Market
description: The traditional public market of Taytay offering fresh produce, meats, seafood, and local goods. A bustling hub of daily commerce where you can source the freshest ingredients for Filipino cooking.

name: Gora Hills Cafe
description: A scenic hillside cafe in Taytay offering premium coffee drinks, light meals, and pastries with a panoramic view of the Rizal skyline. A popular destination for scenic photography and casual meetups.
address: Cabrera Road, Brgy. Dolores, Taytay, Rizal

name: Overlook Cafe Taytay
description: An open-air restaurant and cafe perched on Cabrera Road offering fresh refreshments, grilled items, and sweeping views of Taytay and surrounding areas.

name: The Gathering Cafe
description: A cozy, modern local cafe providing premium espresso drinks, sandwiches, and a peaceful atmosphere ideal for meetings, remote work, or casual hangouts.
address: Manila East Road, Brgy. San Juan, Taytay, Rizal

name: Chikin Samgyupsal Taytay
description: Popular Korean BBQ restaurant in Brgy. Dolores offering unlimited samgyupsal (grilled pork belly), side dishes (banchan), and local Filipino favorites at budget-friendly prices.
address: Manila East Road, Brgy. Dolores, Taytay, Rizal

name: Monalisa Bakery & Sweets
description: A long-standing local bakery in Poblacion famous for its traditional Filipino breads, custom celebration cakes, kalamay, and native sweets — a community staple for decades.

name: Sienna Hills Private Resort
description: A private swimming pool resort in the elevated Dolores area offering clean pool facilities, function rooms, and open picnic grounds for family gatherings and group staycations.
address: Sienna Hills, Brgy. Dolores, Taytay, Rizal

name: Drift Motor Speedway
description: An indoor karting facility in Taytay offering high-energy go-kart racing for individuals, families, and corporate groups. Features a professionally designed circuit with safety barriers and modern karts.

name: Taytay Town Plaza
description: The historic town plaza adjacent to the Minor Basilica, serving as the community's traditional gathering place since the Spanish colonial era. Features monuments, benches, and a peaceful public garden.

name: Tres Marias Monument
description: A civic monument at the heart of the Poblacion commemorating notable figures in Taytay's local history. A recognized local landmark visible from the main road.

name: Christ the King Parish
description: A beautifully designed modern parish church in Suburban Heights, serving as a landmark and spiritual community center for the eastern barangays of Taytay.
address: Suburban Heights, Brgy. San Juan, Taytay, Rizal

name: Taytay Municipal Hall
description: The seat of local government for the Municipality of Taytay. The municipal hall complex serves as the administrative center where civic affairs, public services, and community events are conducted.

name: Manggahan Floodway Linear Park
description: A scenic floodway park stretching along the Manggahan Floodway channel. The embankment is developed with jogging paths, benches, and open green spaces — a popular spot for morning runs and weekend relaxation.

name: Taytay Sports Complex
description: The municipal sports and recreation center offering basketball courts, covered gymnasiums, and open fields used for local league games, community events, and recreational activities.

name: Taytay Night Market (Paluto Area)
description: A popular night market and paluto (cook-to-order seafood) strip near the municipal area offering fresh seafood, barbecue stalls, and a lively street food atmosphere in the evenings.

name: Sto. Niño Parish Chapel (Dolores)
description: A local parish chapel dedicated to the Holy Child Jesus (Sto. Niño) in Barangay Dolores, serving as a spiritual center for the barangay community and holding feast day celebrations each January.
